verdict.rationale: Cline is itself a coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence only shows client-side MCP use (connecting to and managing external MCP servers) and ACP embedding. ACP is a different protocol. Nothing shows Cline running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
